title: Pointwise slice mass bound 4.9: M_W(⟨T,f,t₋⟩) ≤ L_W·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ_T(W ∩ {t−h ≤ f ≤ t})
statement: For all P, m ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ D_{m+1}(U), every (μ, v) with IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v, μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U and |v(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm(α) for all x, α, every f : ℝ^P → ℝ which is L-Lipschitz on U, every t ∈ ℝ and every S ∈ D_m(U) with IsSlice T f t S, every open W ⊆ U and every LW ≥ 0 with ‖Df(x)‖ ≤ LW for Lebesgue-a.e. x ∈ W: M_W(S) ≤ LW·liminf_{h→0+} μ(W ∩ f⁻¹([t − h, t]))/h, in [0,∞] with 0·∞ = 0 (liminf along 𝓝[>] 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ (t : ℝ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U m), IsSlice T f t S → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ LW : ℝ≥0, (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl P)), x ∈ W → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖₊ ≤ LW) → S.massOn W ≤ (LW : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => μ (W ∩ f ⁻¹' Icc (t - h) t) / ENNReal.ofReal h) (𝓝[>] 0)
